metadata.title: n8n Provisioning Platform
metadata.description: Deploy and manage self-hosted n8n instances

hero.badge: Deploy n8n in seconds, not hours
hero.subtitle: Launch your own n8n workflow automation platform on AWS in minutes. No DevOps expertise required. Full control, zero complexity.

features.title: Everything You Need to Run n8n
features.subtitle: Enterprise-grade infrastructure with the simplicity of a managed service

oneClickDeploy.title: One-Click Deployment
oneClickDeploy.description: Launch a fully configured n8n instance on AWS with a single click. We handle all the infrastructure setup.

security.title: Enterprise Security
security.description: Isolated VPC, encrypted databases, secure secrets management, and automatic security updates.

autoScaling.title: Auto-Scaling
autoScaling.description: Automatically scale your resources based on workload. Pay only for what you use.

database.title: Managed Database
database.description: PostgreSQL RDS with automated backups, point-in-time recovery, and high availability.

monitoring.title: Real-Time Monitoring
monitoring.description: Built-in CloudWatch monitoring, custom alerts, and comprehensive logging for all your workflows.

customDomain.title: Custom Domain
customDomain.description: Use your own domain with SSL certificates. We handle DNS configuration and certificate renewal.

howItWorks.title: Deploy in 3 Simple Steps
howItWorks.subtitle: From signup to running workflows in under 5 minutes

step1.title: Choose Your Configuration
step1.description: Select your instance size, region, and n8n version. We have pre-configured options for every use case.
step1.detail: Small, Medium, Large instances • 15+ AWS regions • Latest n8n versions

step2.title: Launch Your Instance
step2.description: Click deploy and watch as we provision your infrastructure. Full AWS stack created automatically.
step2.detail: ECS Fargate • RDS PostgreSQL • Application Load Balancer • Auto-scaling

step3.title: Start Building Workflows
step3.description: Access your n8n instance through a secure URL and start creating powerful automation workflows.
step3.detail: 500+ integrations • Visual workflow builder • Webhook endpoints • API access
